statutory_elements: Deceptive generation of 'Collect Request' misrepresented to citizen as payment credit or refund
Inducement to enter UPI PIN under false pretext that PIN is required to receive money
Instantaneous electronic debit and routing to suspect Virtual Payment Address (VPA)
legal_sections.notes: UPI transfers settle instantly. Beneficiary VPAs and handles must be flagged on the NCRP portal within the 1930 Golden Hour window to intercept ATM cash-outs.
